# Theme 2: The End-to-End ML Workflow {.unnumbered}

In Theme 1 you trained models on datasets that were ready to use. A real project needs more: you need to understand the problem, explore and prepare the data, and check that the model is good enough before anyone uses it. In this theme you first go through all stages of a project once, in one small example, and then study the main stages in depth.

## Activities

Work through the activities in order:

1. [End-to-End ML Project](015_end_to_end_ml.ipynb): one project from start to finish, with a section for each stage of CRISP-DM. It also explains why Data Preparation comes before Data Understanding in this theme.
2. [Data Preparation](005_data_prep.ipynb): scaling, transforming, merging and encoding data, and handling missing values.
3. [Data Understanding](006_data_understanding.ipynb): distributions, relationships between variables, and principal component analysis (PCA).
4. [Modeling & Evaluation](007_modeling_and_evaluation.ipynb): cross-validation, validation and test sets, feature and model selection, hyperparameter tuning, overfitting, and metrics for classification and regression.

In [Theme 3](theme-3.qmd), you look inside three models and see how they learn.
